content: Nakoh ci kaɗ ŋ findi ɓooɓi kiimohan Kooh
Mbaa ini uup raak njiriñ, weɗ mi na hee woye paaɗ : Mi na ñaahohe ne ɓi Janguuni nik ŋ kiim Kooh, ɓa kiimee keeh-keeh wuu ɓooɓi jen, wa hun na corkiɗ Kooh.
Ɓa kiimɗee buur ci na kilifaaciŋ kur ci jen ne ɓoo min raak kipes yeeɓkiɗ huniɗ na jam, ɓoo haɓɗee in yurhiɗ ŋ fiki Kooh, na mandohaaɗ baahiɗ keeh-keeh.
Ineem weɗ moɗ te weɗ neɓ Kooh Mucɗohiŋ ɓoo,
Kooh yi waaɗ ne ɓo' ci jen muc te ɓa kaɗ po ɓa min inah keeh ki.

content.text: ŋ harmban Kooh na ɓo' ci.
A Kiristaani Yeesu, te a ɓo',
yi eɗoh kiñin kiŋ ɗe haf ce
ne a romkoh ɓo' ci jen.

content: Ineem weɗ Kooh teeɓoh wi jamanooni a gapohee wa ree.
Ŋ pangkiŋ Kooh weem, a tummba so yegɗohoh na Apootar ne ŋ jangɗee ɓi nikɗi Yawuut kosi na keeh ki. Mi na woye keeh, ŋ leyɗi.
Mbaa ŋ waaɗ ne, ŋ ɗisik nu ɗu coh ɗah, ƴaar ci kiimee Kooh, ɓa raɗsee Kooh yaah hooliɗ, wa hunuu na ayruk na taastiɗoh.

Ŋ namiɗ waaɗ ne ɓitiɓ ci liiɓ baahiɗ ŋ kulɓaaci ɓa na ɓekke, ɓa haɓɗukee na kulɓa yiwiɗ, eɗuuɗ cir. Ɓa haɓɗukuu haɓɗuk uupiɗ ŋ haf ciŋ ɓa, na urus ci wala per ci ɓa na tokke, na kulɓaaci na care kopor laayiɗ.
Waaye haɓɗukiŋ ɓa nikaat tum in baahiɗ findi ɓitɓi woo ne a nikiɗ Kooh.
Ɓitiɓ joy joy kerhiɗ jangɗohoh ci, a jangee na yeeɓuk.
Ŋ teyɗohɗi ɓitiɓ ne a jangɗohee wala a adgiɗ ƴaar ; a joy joy ɗek.
Laam, a Aadama ɗeɓ mahu, Aawa taammba nga.
Te a Aadama ñaañohu haa, a ɓitɓa a yi ñaañohu, a kerhiɗeeɗi Kooh, a keennda ŋ bakaaɗ.
Waaye raakiŋ ɓitiɓ ci kuɓu hondohɗi ɓa mucɗu
ne ɓa ris kosiɗ Kooh, ɓa waaɗ ɗe, ɓa pesee pes hooliɗ wuu ce te peseem hun na amb haf ɓa ɗah.

footnotes.text: Ŋ jamanoonaam, wa raakeen ɓi ɓitiɓ nga, ɓa nikee heɗ raak-raak, ɓa raakee hot-hot wiiriis ŋ waas-Kooh, an ɓo' joyee nik liiɓ dong, faan baahɗi. Wa kaɗta po ɓa sannga sah raak kuɓu. Raakiɗ liiɓoh ci amb ne ɓitiɓ ceem jeemeen ɓek liiɓohaaɗeem ŋ Janguuni. Wa miniɗ nik ne weɗ tah po Pool woosa ini a woo ŋ ndii.
